302.description: Redirect to client redirect_uri with code

hash.description: Content hash once downloaded; pass as `?v=` for immutable caching.

BadBackendFailure.description: Record of a runtime transcode backend failure tracked with a TTL (M4.9).

CreateOptimizedRequest.description: Request to create an optimized version for an item or library (M5.4).

CreateOptimizedResponse.description: Result of creating or previewing (`dry_run`) an optimized version (M5.4).

token.description: Shown once upon creation; never stored in plaintext.

Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Its encoding is owned by the repository that issues it.

path.description: `None` for the virtual top level (filesystem root list).

HailoDeviceInfo.description: Detected Hailo NPU device details (`/dev/h1x-*` or `/dev/hailo*`).

HailoPipelineCapability.description: AI media pipelines accelerated by Hailo-8 / Hailo-8L / Hailo-10H.

HailoRuntimeStatus.description: Live runtime status and co-tenant sharing state of the Hailo NPU.

HailoSharingMode.description: Cooperative NPU sharing mode (`[hw.hailo] mode` in config, ADR 0006).

HardwareFingerprint.description: Complete hardware fingerprint of the host machine.

driverFingerprint.description: Stable SHA-256 hex digest of the hardware + driver state so self-tests re-run on driver changes.

HwCapEntry.description: One row in `hw_capabilities` recording the result of a functional decode/encode self-test (M4.3).

HwReport.description:
Complete hardware acceleration report returned by `GET /api/v1/hw/report`, `get_hw_report`,
and `mbl://hw/report` (M4.15, M4.16).

HwSelftestResponse.description: Response returned when triggering a hardware self-test (`POST /api/v1/hw/test` and `run_hw_selftest`).

InviteRow.description: Invitation to register with pre-assigned permissions.

ItemSummary.description: Compact item for grids and rows.

McpConfigSnippets.description: Ready-to-copy configuration snippets for popular AI agents and IDEs.

McpPreset.description: Preset permission bundle for the Token Wizard.

McpSnippetsRequest.description: Request to generate client configuration snippets for connecting an AI agent.

McpStatus.description: Administrative status and toggle for the MCP subsystem.

NetworkClass.description: The network environment from which a request originated.

NpuProfile.description: Detected Neural Processing Unit (NPU) accelerator profile (M4.1, M4.17).

items.description: Compact item for grids and rows.

PlatformProfile.description: Hardware platform class used to pick defaults and hardware transcode pipelines (M4.1).

PlayMethod.description: Overall delivery method chosen by the decision engine.

PlaybackMarker.description: Timeline marker (intro, credits, chapter) returned in [`PlaybackResponse`].

QuickConnectAuthorizeRequest.description: Request from an authenticated user's phone/browser to authorize a 6-digit TV code (M5.8).

QuickConnectInitRequest.description: Request to initiate a Quick-Connect 6-digit login code for `mbl-tv` (M5.8).

QuickConnectPollRequest.description: Request from the TV client polling whether its Quick-Connect secret has been authorized (M5.8).

ReachabilityReport.description: Outcome of the CGNAT and external reachability inspection.

SceneHintInput.description: Input scene hint for indexing keyframes on an item (M5.13).

SceneSearchHit.description: Semantic scene search match returned by `GET /api/v1/ai/search-scenes` (M5.13).

pin.description: 4-8 numeric digits, or null to remove PIN.

StreamAction.description: Action to take for an individual video or audio stream.

SubtitleDelivery.description: How subtitles will be delivered for the session.

SystemHealthReport.description: System health snapshot including thermal/power monitoring and platform defaults (M5.1, M5.2).

TailscalePeer.description: A peer on the tailnet and whether the connection is direct or relayed.

TailscaleStatus.description: Current status of the Tailscale node on the host.

TailscaleWhois.description: Resolved identity of a tailnet caller from LocalAPI `whois`.

ThermalStatus.description: Snapshot of host thermal and power status.

idleJobsPaused.description: Whether background idle jobs (`Priority::Idle`) are paused due to high temperature (≥ 75 °C) or active throttling.

rawThrottled.description: Raw Raspberry Pi `get_throttled` bitmask, if available.

temperatureC.description: Current SoC / CPU temperature in degrees Celsius, if readable.

throttlingOccurred.description: Thermal throttling has occurred since last boot (`bit 18` or `bit 19`).

underVoltageOccurred.description: Under-voltage has occurred since last boot (`bit 16`).

uri.description: `otpauth://` URI ready for QR code generation.

TranscodeCapacity.description: Live transcode capacity summary derived from hardware profile, self-test FPS, and active sessions (M4.11).

UpdateMcpStatusRequest.description: Request payload to update MCP status (e.g. kill-switch toggle).

hiddenHubs.description: Hub keys hidden by the user on the Home screen.

UserSecurityInfo.description: Security and access profile for a user.
